costNote: Claims paid to policyholders — device repairs and replacements, housing claims and the like. Reportable catastrophes added $19.7M inside Global Housing this quarter.

opex.name: Underwriting, selling, general & administrative
opex.note: Assurant's model is partner-heavy: commissions and revenue shares to the mobile carriers, automakers, lenders and property managers who distribute its products, plus operating costs. This is where most of the money goes.

takeaways.title: Outlook raised

takeaways.text: Connected Living earnings grew 23% (phone supply-chain volumes and device protection), driving Global Lifestyle Adjusted EBITDA up 15% to $237M.
takeaways.title: Phones are the engine
